Messages.Author: lactamaeon
Messages.Body:


Unless I'm mistaken, all of these effects also deal environmental
damage, because none of them specify that the damage is caused by the
minion. This means that, like Weather Control, Saulot takes the damage
normally.

John

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Correct. Environmental sources (including Talbot's Chainsaw's untap
damage, Rutor's Hand, self-inflicted damage from striking with Block
Gloves or Zip Gun, Force of Will, &c.) are not affected by Saulot's
special.

Messages.Author: Daneel
Messages.Body:
On 6 Apr 2006 10:52:43 -0700, wilso...@gmail.com
<wilso...@gmail.com> wrote:



As a general rule, minions only inflict damage that 1) comes from their
strike in combat, or 2) comes from a (non-errataed - e.g. self-inflicted
damage has no particular source) source that explicitly states that this
vampire is inflicting the damage.

If Saulot joins the Sabbat, and Jaroslav Pascek becomes a Baali, he cannot
inflict 1 damage on Saulot, because by his text it is reduced to zero. If
Petaniqua the Baali, when in combat with Saulot, strikes hands at close
range, the damage inflicted would be reduced to zero. In the vast majority
of apparently questionable cases the source of the damage is an effect
generated by a card played by the Baali (rather than the Baali himself).
